assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a separate full-body cutout of this same fictional scientist for a post-apocalyptic imperial orbital research programme. Preserve his recognizable face, receding swept-back brown hair, short full beard, round wire glasses, ivory long lab coat over charcoal waistcoat and dark trousers. Change pose: he stands in a natural three-quarter stance, looking thoughtfully down toward a clipboard of orbital calculations in his left hand; right hand holds a pencil just above the clipboard. Clipboard has only faint simple orbital diagram marks, no readable words. Clear anatomically correct separated hands and five fingers, clipboard supported naturally. Entire body and both black shoes visible with generous margin. Realistic painterly military concept art, restrained worn fabrics, warm ivory and charcoal palette with subtle cool light. ONE PERSON ONLY. Absolutely no desk, chair, computer, building, space scene or ground. Genuine transparent alpha background with clean edges, no opaque vignette or cast shadow, no labels or logos.

Use case: stylized-concept. One separate isolated prop asset for a HOI4 post-apocalyptic Khan empire focus about orbital trajectory calculations. A compact heavy retrofuturist scientific computing console, three-quarter front view, dark olive-gray steel casing, a sloped control desk with orderly analog switches, cream buttons and trackball, TWO inset green phosphor CRT screens above. One screen has a sparse luminous orbital ellipse around a simple circle, the second a sparse trajectory graph and waveform. No legible lettering, no text, no brand or flag. Worn but operational bunker laboratory equipment, realistic painted concept-art materials, small brass fittings, subtle burgundy switch guards and modest amber indicator lamps. Deep sides and sturdy lower cabinet completely visible; one neatly coiled cable attached to side. Strong compact silhouette for easy collage, restrained detail that reads at small size. Entire console fits with transparent margin on all sides. NO scientist, hands, fingers, chair, room, background, separate loose objects, external floor or smoke. Genuine transparent alpha outside the console and through gaps. Neutral warm key light and mild cool edge light; screens luminous but no broad baked surrounding glow.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE separate fictional orbital apparatus asset for a post-apocalyptic strategy game, a threatening but believable retrofuturist satellite, clean three-quarter view, diagonal silhouette. Compact cylindrical graphite-gray body with concentric armored segments, cream ceramic thermal panels, muted burgundy service markings, one large recessed circular gold-toned aperture on its front, a small antenna dish on top, and two SHORT folding dark solar-array wings with copper frames. This is atmospheric fictional concept art, not a technical schematic. Mechanical detail realistic and readable, no exposed huge weapon barrel, no missiles, no beam firing. Worn industrial military aesthetic matching bunker scientific equipment, metallic warm edge highlights and subtle cool fill, no colorful cartoon stylization. Subject entirely inside canvas, all antenna tips and panel corners visible with generous transparent margin. No Earth, stars, space backdrop, orbit rings, ground, supports, text, labels, logos, people or other objects. Single isolated spacecraft on genuinely transparent alpha background, clean silhouette, no halo or opaque shadow.
